title: The demo agent's frozen source snapshot carries links without share tracking
steps: S1: Freeze research whose source ref is an instagram.com profile link carrying igsh and utm_source, with freezeAgentResearch, and read sources[0].data.ref.
S2: Read a snapshot stored before the clean-up (tracked ref, hash over that data) with checkedResearch.
expect: S1: the ref is https://www.instagram.com/harbour.sportclub/ and the bundle text holds neither igsh nor utm_.
